rubric_items.reason: All 17 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-17) are traced by at least one story; no assumed REQs exist in the intent.
Most stories carry one outcome; S-5 bundles the unchanged-tables constraint with the separate no-medical-history/no-contact-details outcome.
ACs are Given/When/Then with 60/61/300-character boundaries and one case per status; S-1 AC1 over-specifies 'directly after' Status, which can fail a correct implementation.
60 and 300 come from the intent; 61 is derived inline as one character over 60; example reason strings are test data, not limits.
Clear, consistent terms matching the glossary statuses and the intent's wording.

findings.text: S-1 AC1 requires the column 'directly after' Status, but REQ-2 and the ticket only say 'after the Status column'; the AC adds a constraint not in the intent and could fail a correct implementation.

cites.quote: placed directly after the Status column

findings.suggested_fix: Say 'placed after the Status column', or cite a source for 'directly after'.

findings.text: S-5 bundles two outcomes: other tables stay unchanged (REQ-10 to REQ-12) and no medical history or contact details in the list (REQ-14, REQ-15). These would read better as separate stories.
findings.suggested_fix: Move S-5 AC4 (REQ-14, REQ-15) into its own data-protection story.
